info.title: packio-web contract requests
info.description: Endpoints packio-web needs and packio-api has not published. A request, not a contract: the backend owns the contract (api-conventions §1). The why for each operation is its row in docs/contract-requests.md (`x-contract-request`). Generated by `pnpm gen:api` from src/lib/api/requests — do not edit.
